### God's Servants the Prophets
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/gods-servants-prophets
Passage: Amos 3:1-8
Points:
- Impenitent sin inevitably incurs God's holy discipline and judgment upon a nation or church.
- Israel's punishment stemmed from their special covenant relationship with God, aimed at purifying His community.
- God demonstrates mercy by revealing His plans through prophets, giving sinners advance warning to repent and avert disaster.
- Like a person terrified by a roaring lion, Amos felt compelled to proclaim God's urgent message.
- Divine foreknowledge of how people will react does not remove our responsibility to repent when confronted with truth.
